name: The Forest's Bounty

angles.text: Gathering Shadowgale acorns showcases how local wild nuts can be roasted into simple forest fare, making it of keen interest to culinary foragers.

aliases: who gives the forest bounty quest
faq.answer: A nervous forager resting near Shadowgale Forest requests assistance. Having collected all the safe acorns nearby, they need a hardy adventurer to venture deeper into the woods where dangerous wildlife roams.
faq.q: Who asks you to gather the acorns?

faq.answer: Shadowgale Acorns are scattered across the ground beneath the canopy of Shadowgale Forest. Foragers must search the forest floor while staying watchful for hostile predators lurking among the trees.

The forest floor is prowled by predatory raptor-like birds. These aggressive creatures make straying far from camp extremely hazardous for ordinary folk who lack martial training to defend themselves.
faq.q: Why is collecting acorns dangerous here?

faq.answer: The acorns serve as a hearty wild food source. Once collected, they are meant to be roasted over a fire into a warm, nutty snack to share with those willing to brave the forest beasts.
faq.q: What are the acorns used for?

faq.answer: The quest giver describes them as dangerous 'raptor-bird things' hunting in Shadowgale Forest. These avian or reptilian predators are large enough and vicious enough to view an unwary traveler as their next meal.
faq.q: What are the raptor-bird creatures mentioned in the forest?

faq.answer: While tough or bitter off the ground, the forager specifically notes that Shadowgale Acorns become a delicious treat once properly roasted over heat.
faq.q: How are the acorns prepared for eating?

sections.body: A cautious forager seeking food in Shadowgale Forest finds themselves in a bind. While acorns lie scattered across the woodland floor, the surrounding trees are prowled by fierce, raptor-like creatures. Having gathered whatever fell near safety, the forager depends on passing travelers to venture into the wilder groves so that neither goes hungry.
sections.title: A Perilous Foraging Run

sections.body: Shadowgale Acorns provide hearty sustenance for those who know how to prepare them. Though bitter or tough in the raw, roasting them over a crackling fire transforms the wild harvest into a rich, roasted treat. Braving the predatory birds among the timber turns a simple woodland scavenge into a warm meal shared in the wilderness.
sections.title: Roasting the Harvest

summary: The Forest's Bounty is a local quest in Shadowgale Forest where a timid forager asks for help collecting fallen acorns. Fierce predatory raptor-birds prowl the deeper woods, making harvesting too perilous without an adventurer's protection. The gathered acorns are then roasted into a tasty forest meal.
